headwords: chữa lợn lành thành lợn què
con có cha như nhà có nóc
con hư tại mẹ, cháu hư tại bà

flags.why: This expression disparages unmarried pregnant women and needs a derogatory warning ([VOV](https://amp.vov.vn/tinh-yeu-gia-dinh/dung-de-phu-nu-them-dau-long-voi-hai-tieng-chua-hoang-454989.vov)).
The expression means being overdue without specifying a 42-week threshold ([source](https://dicungcon.vn/danh-cho-ban/chua-trau-la-gi-article1338)).
flags.fix: overdue (of a pregnancy continuing well beyond the expected due date)

flags.why: The example defines the character category instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Trong bản Nôm này, tiếng “sang” được ghi bằng một chữ kép. = In this Nôm text, the word “sang” is written with a compound phonogram.

flags.why: This contemptuous expression refers to an adult woman and does not require her to be old ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-con%20m%E1%BA%B9)).
This sense denotes the numeral one or a score of one, not an ordinal meaning “the first one” ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/con_m%E1%BB%99t)).
flags.fix: the numeral one; a score of one

flags.why: The example incorrectly uses “con một” as an ordinal instead of the numeral or score sense ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/con_m%E1%BB%99t)).
flags.fix: Không học bài nên nó bị con một. = It got a score of one because it hadn't studied.
